title: Higgsfield × Seedance 2.5 — 30s scenes + 50 reference images (capability signal)
gap: Not an opportunity itself — a funded model race. The window it opens: consistent-character long-form for civilians (a child's year-in-video, a novel chapter as film, photo-book-style memory films) just moved from impossible to plausible.

zh.gap: 它本身不是机会——那是烧钱的模型军备赛。它打开的窗口是：普通人的「角色一致长内容」（孩子的一年成长片、小说章节成片、相册级回忆影片）刚从不可能变成可信。
zh.pain: 所有想把 AI 视频做长的人都撞过同一堵墙：换个镜头，角色就换了张脸。
zh.kill: CapCut、可灵、即梦几个月内都会补上同等能力；套壳窗口很薄、关得很快。
zh.move: 这里没有可动手的东西。留档是为了给「角色不再漂移」记下日期——从这一天起，上面那类 R1 味道的产品变得可行。

pain: Anyone who tried to make an AI video longer than a clip hit the same wall: the character changes face between shots.
kill: Every consumer video app (CapCut, Kling, 即梦) will surface the same capability within months; the wrapper window is thin and closes fast.
move: Nothing to build here. Archived as the dated marker of when 'characters stop drifting' became true — the R1-flavoured products above become feasible from this point on.
